limitations: Survey year labels governments with different fiscal-year end dates; do not relabel as a single nationwide fiscal calendar.
T*, E* and F* are separate tax/current-operations/construction subtotals, not full revenue/expenditure or locally purchased goods. Payroll is included in current operations.
Absent item codes are omitted by the publisher; missing government-level groups are not zero. DC has no separately reported state-government group.
The combined state-and-local group is the publisher aggregate. Do not sum state and local totals as a consolidated budget. Territories are outside these files.
Component-sum sampling uncertainty is not computed; item CVs do not provide covariance. 2022 is the quinquennial census; other local aggregates are survey estimates.
